mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (place_id, creator_id, title, description, start_time, end_time, max_members, status, created_at) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{creatorId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxMembers}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, place_id, creator_id, title, description, start_time, end_time, max_members, status, created_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.place_id AS placeId, a.creator_id AS creatorId, u.nickname AS creatorNickname, a.title, a.description, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.max_members AS maxMembers, a.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_member m WHERE m.activity_id = a.id) AS joinedCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM activity_member m2 WHERE m2.activity_id = a.id AND m2.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS joined FROM activity a INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.creator_id
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
